about: The Power Analysis card's one geometry contract. Each stat row holds its label, four ball sockets and its digit; the converter checks that card32.px.js draws a socket at every stats row by socket column and nowhere else, and the builder generates the bank-3 ball rows, ball columns and digit addresses from the same rows. Rows 0-7 are the CHR $18 title band, row 8 the split strip and rows 9-29 CHR $06.
